method.primary_unit: Task; average two repeats per condition; retain both attempts and all valid zeros.
method.score_test: Exact two-sided condition-label sign-flip test on 60 task-paired pass-count differences.
method.intervals: Percentile paired-task bootstrap,100000 resamples, fixed NumPy RNG seed20261031; same resampled task indices for both conditions. Descriptive95% intervals, no multiplicity correction for secondary metrics or subgroups.
method.efficiency: Model agent execution only; excludes setup/grading/downtime. One valid memory-limit failure included. Unreported external-interruption usage stays null.
method.code: Unified-diff changed physical lines. Reviewed test paths plus path conventions separate tests/fixtures, documentation, examples, source extensions, other files. Reviewed Rust cfg(test) suffixes separated. Source proxy excludes blank and comment-looking lines using hunk-local lexical rules; inline comments remain code, docstring/string ambiguity possible. This is not an AST complexity measure.
method.scope: Fresh60 study only; selected from83 remaining tasks, quota sampling,52 unseen repositories and8 previously seen repositories; no imported scores.
method.original_score: Model-complete infrastructure-interrupted graders replaced by first valid same-patch official grade; native originals preserved. Ordinary scored zeros and12 test-overlay observations remain unchanged.

interruption_usage.note: Interrupted attempts only. Do not add to primarypairedresources. Nullusage means unreported, notmeasuredzero.

posthoc_sensitivity.method: Remove entire tasks from both conditions, both repeats. Selected after outcomes; different population, not corrected official scores and not an estimate of hypothetical regrades.
